predecessors.name: Kingdom of the Franks
predecessors.text: the county of Aragon: Ansó, Echo and Canfranc, centred on Jaca

successors.name: Kingdom of Pamplona
successors.text: the county of Aragon: Ansó, Echo and Canfranc, centred on Jaca

ledger.x: 807: the Carolingian county of Aragon is first attested.
820: Aznar I is ejected and the county breaks from the Franks.
922: the county is absorbed by Pamplona.
922: Galindo Aznárez II dies without surviving legitimate sons and the County of Aragon becomes part of the crown of Navarre.

wars.name: Frankish conquest of the Aragon valleys
wars.outcome: 'A number of castles were established in Aragon between 798 and 802' and Navarre and Aragon 'came under Carolingian overlordship between 794 and 806' (Spanish March page).

certainty.note: A valley county of three named valleys; no boundary line is recorded on the page.
